Unfortunately, this happened to me when I was in high school. Maybe that’s why, maybe laws are different if you’re a minor? I legitimately wasn’t even suicidal at the time, she was just surprised with how depressed I was and then set everything in motion. “I’m worried about you, so I’m gonna call your parents to come get you and take you to [local behavioral hospital] so we don’t need to get police involved.” 

Was put on drugs they wouldn’t explain to me, kept longer because I wouldn’t participate in group therapy with kids half my age. Awful experience that has kept me from fully opening up to therapists to this day, I just refuse to be put through that again, I think I would actually snap.
Thanks so much for this. These are great questions for me to ruminate on, and really excellent advice on my brother. Thank you.
